rule: Preserve source paths byte-for-byte for the first dedicated-repository seed. Any path/content restructuring is a new change and invalidates affected evidence.
acceptance_after_migration: Verify every required entry blob/tree SHA matches this manifest.
Verify repository is not douluo511/Geometry-Lotto-Pro and contains no other project code.
Run the full frozen Happy8 workflow on the dedicated repository exact commit.
Create real Release N and N+1 only from the dedicated repository.
Run real updater N→N+1 through trusted HTTPS manifest/artifact, rollback and restart recovery.
Rebuild/freeze the final Exact EXE, physically click all four GUI entries, then prove post-GUI Same Hash.
Only then generate FINAL_ARTIFACT.json and evaluate E17/E18/E19 and Final Gate.
